notes.title: The Neverwhere Tales - Book 1 Early Access Release
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

the Early Access of The Neverwhere Tales - Book 1 is finally here on Steam.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739838/0455bb19642e18cb871c4f084519f6f2e16a65c0.png

That means, you'll get access to 5 Chapters with: 

 Over 7000 renders in full HD quality
 Over 150 animations
 A story with over 135000 words
 An image gallery
 A scene replay gallery
 A gallery for cinematics
 Achievement functionality with 57 achievements


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739838/827b41a9bc326e1f83ff6cac2962f661b7534881.png
To celebrate the release, we are launching the special bundle Heroic Hearts & Urban Myths in collaboration with Glowing Stones: Heroes' Awakening, which also releases its new Chapter today.
And even if you already own Glowing Stones, you can add The Neverwhere Tales to your collection through the bundle and enjoy an additional 10% off.
